input_messages.content: Hi! I'm having trouble sending MMS messages from my messaging app for the past few hours. I would like to get this fixed so I can send MMS messages again. Can you help me with that?
My phone number is 555-123-2002, and my name is John Smith. Let me know if you need any other information to verify my account.
My status bar shows that airplane mode is on, and my battery is at 80%. Also, I confirmed that my messaging app cannot send MMS messages. What should I do next?
I turned off airplane mode. Now my status bar shows poor signal strength, 2G network technology, and mobile data is disabled. What should I do next?
I turned mobile data on. Now my status bar shows poor signal strength, 2G network, and data enabled. The network mode preference is set to 2G only. What should I do next?
I changed the network mode preference to 4G/5G preferred. Now my status bar shows excellent signal strength, 5G network technology, and data enabled. What should I do next?
I checked again, but my messaging app still cannot send MMS messages even with excellent 5G signal and data enabled. What should I try next?
My current APN name is "internet" and the MMSC URL for picture messages is "http://mms.carrier.com/mms/wapenc". What should I do next?
Wi-Fi Calling is currently turned off on my phone. What should I do next?
The messaging app has permission for "sms" and "phone," but it does not have permission for "storage." What should I do next?
I granted the messaging app the "storage" permission, but it still cannot send MMS messages. What should I try next?
I restarted the phone, but the messaging app still cannot send MMS messages. I'm getting a bit frustrated since this has been going on for hours. What else can we try?
The speed test failed due to no connection. VPN is turned off, and Data Saver mode is off as well. What should I do next?

My phone's network status shows airplane mode is off, SIM card is active, cellular connection is connected with excellent signal on 5G. Mobile data is enabled, but data roaming is disabled. Wi-Fi is off and not connected. What should I do next?
Yes, I am currently abroad in France, so I am outside my home network. Should I enable data roaming on my phone?

I turned data roaming on. The speed test now shows an excellent connection with 275 Mbps download speed. Also, my messaging app can send MMS messages now. It looks like the issue is fixed. Is there anything else I should check or do?

Thank you for your help and clear guidance throughout the process. No, that's all I needed help with today. I appreciate your support in getting my MMS working again. Have a great day! 

###STOP###

messages.content: Hi! How can I help you today?
Hi! I'm having trouble sending MMS messages from my messaging app for the past few hours. I would like to get this fixed so I can send MMS messages again. Can you help me with that?
I can help with that. First I need to identify your account. Please give me the phone number on your account. You can also give me your customer ID, or your full name and date of birth.
My phone number is 555-123-2002, and my name is John Smith. Let me know if you need any other information to verify my account.

{"customer_id": "C1001", "full_name": "John Smith", "date_of_birth": "1985-06-15", "email": "john.smith@example.com", "phone_number": "555-123-2002", "address": {"street": "123 Main St", "city": "Anytown", "state": "CA", "zip_code": "90210"}, "account_status": "Active", "payment_methods": [{"method_type": "Credit Card", "account_number_last_4": "1235", "expiration_date": "12/2026"}], "line_ids": ["L1001", "L1002", "L1003"], "bill_ids": ["B1001", "B1002", "B1003"], "created_at": "2025-01-15 10:30:00", "last_extension_date": null, "goodwill_credit_used_this_year": 25.0}

{"line_id": "L1002", "phone_number": "555-123-2002", "status": "Active", "plan_id": "P1002", "device_id": "D1002", "data_used_gb": 8.7, "data_refueling_gb": 0.0, "roaming_enabled": true, "contract_end_date": "2026-12-31", "last_plan_change_date": "2024-12-15", "last_sim_replacement_date": "2025-01-20", "suspension_start_date": null}

{"line_id": "L1003", "phone_number": "555-123-2003", "status": "Suspended", "plan_id": "P1001", "device_id": "D1003", "data_used_gb": 0.0, "data_refueling_gb": 0.0, "roaming_enabled": false, "contract_end_date": "2026-06-30", "last_plan_change_date": "2024-10-05", "last_sim_replacement_date": null, "suspension_start_date": "2025-02-01"}
{"plan_id": "P1002", "name": "Premium Plan", "data_limit_gb": 15.0, "price_per_month": 65.0, "data_refueling_price_per_gb": 2.0}

Thanks, John. I found your account and the line for 555-123-2002. The line is active, and its data usage is within your plan limit.

Let's run some checks on your phone. Please do these and tell me what each one shows:

1. Check your status bar. What do you see for airplane mode, signal strength, network technology (such as 5G, 4G, 3G or 2G), and mobile data?
2. Run `can_send_mms` to confirm the messaging app can't send MMS.
Status Bar: ✈️ Airplane Mode | 🔋 80%
Your messaging app cannot send MMS messages.
My status bar shows that airplane mode is on, and my battery is at 80%. Also, I confirmed that my messaging app cannot send MMS messages. What should I do next?

Airplane mode is on. It turns off all wireless connections, including cellular and mobile data, so that's likely why MMS isn't working.

Please use `toggle_airplane_mode` to turn it OFF. Then check your status bar again and tell me what it shows for signal strength, network technology and mobile data.

Airplane Mode is now OFF.
Status Bar: 📶¹ Poor | 2G | 📵 Data Disabled | 🔋 80%
Status Bar: 📶¹ Poor | 2G | 📵 Data Disabled | 🔋 80%
I turned off airplane mode. Now my status bar shows poor signal strength, 2G network technology, and mobile data is disabled. What should I do next?

Two things need fixing: mobile data is disabled, and you're on a 2G network. 2G is generally not suitable for MMS.

First, please use `toggle_data` to turn mobile data ON. Then run `check_network_mode_preference` and tell me what it shows.

Mobile Data is now ON.
Status Bar: 📶¹ Poor | 2G | 📱 Data Enabled | 🔋 80%
Network Mode Preference: 2g_only
I turned mobile data on. Now my status bar shows poor signal strength, 2G network, and data enabled. The network mode preference is set to 2G only. What should I do next?

Your network mode is set to 2G only, which is too slow for MMS and limits your data speed. Please use `set_network_mode_preference` with the mode `"4g_5g_preferred"`. Then check your status bar again and tell me the signal strength and network technology.

Preferred Network Mode set to: 4g_5g_preferred
Status Bar: 📶⁴ Excellent | 5G | 📱 Data Enabled | 🔋 80%
I changed the network mode preference to 4G/5G preferred. Now my status bar shows excellent signal strength, 5G network technology, and data enabled. What should I do next?
Your signal is now excellent on 5G with data enabled. Please run `can_send_mms` again and tell me whether the messaging app can send MMS now.
Your messaging app cannot send MMS messages.
I checked again, but my messaging app still cannot send MMS messages even with excellent 5G signal and data enabled. What should I try next?
Next we'll check your APN settings, because a missing MMSC URL is a common cause of MMS problems. Please run `check_apn_settings` and tell me the APN name and MMSC URL it shows.

Current APN Name: internet
MMSC URL (for picture messages): http://mms.carrier.com/mms/wapenc
(These are technical settings, usually best left unchanged.)
My current APN name is "internet" and the MMSC URL for picture messages is "http://mms.carrier.com/mms/wapenc". What should I do next?

Your MMSC URL is set, so the APN settings look fine. Next I want to check Wi-Fi Calling, because it can interfere with MMS. Please run `check_wifi_calling_status` and tell me whether Wi-Fi Calling is ON or OFF.
Wi-Fi Calling is currently turned OFF.
Wi-Fi Calling is currently turned off on my phone. What should I do next?

Wi-Fi Calling is off, so it isn't the cause. Next we'll check the messaging app's permissions. Please run `check_app_permissions` with app_name="messaging" and tell me which permissions it shows as granted. I'm looking for "storage" and "sms".
App 'messaging' has permission for: sms, phone.
The messaging app has permission for "sms" and "phone," but it does not have permission for "storage." What should I do next?

The messaging app is missing the "storage" permission. It needs that permission to handle media files. Please use `grant_app_permission` with app_name="messaging" and permission="storage". Then run `can_send_mms` again and tell me whether MMS works now.

Success. Permission 'storage' granted to app 'messaging'.
Status Bar: 📶⁴ Excellent | 5G | 📱 Data Enabled | 🔋 80%
Your messaging app cannot send MMS messages.
I granted the messaging app the "storage" permission, but it still cannot send MMS messages. What should I try next?
Since the permission is now granted, let's restart the phone so the changes fully apply. Please use `reboot_device`. When it's back on, run `can_send_mms` again and tell me whether MMS works.

Restarting network services...
Status Bar: 📶⁴ Excellent | 5G | 📱 Data Enabled | 🔋 80%
Your messaging app cannot send MMS messages.
I restarted the phone, but the messaging app still cannot send MMS messages. I'm getting a bit frustrated since this has been going on for hours. What else can we try?

I'm sorry this is taking so long, John. We've covered the main MMS causes, and there are still a few checks left. MMS needs working mobile data, so let's confirm that next.

Please run these and tell me what each one shows:
1. `run_speed_test`: what download speed and connection quality does it report?
2. `check_vpn_status`: is a VPN connected?
3. `check_data_restriction_status`: is Data Saver on?
Speed test failed: No Connection.
VPN is turned OFF.
Data Saver mode is OFF.
The speed test failed due to no connection. VPN is turned off, and Data Saver mode is off as well. What should I do next?

A speed test with no connection means mobile data isn't working, even though your status bar shows 5G and data enabled. That would explain why MMS still fails.

Your line is active, it's roaming enabled on our side, and its data usage is within your plan limit. Next I'd like to check the phone's own network settings. Please run `check_network_status` and tell me what it shows for:
- Airplane mode
- Signal strength and network type
- Mobile data
- Data roaming

Airplane Mode: OFF
SIM Card Status: active
Cellular Connection: connected
Cellular Signal: excellent
Cellular Network Type: 5G
Mobile Data Enabled: Yes
Data Roaming Enabled: No
Wi-Fi Radio: OFF
Wi-Fi Connected: No

My phone's network status shows airplane mode is off, SIM card is active, cellular connection is connected with excellent signal on 5G. Mobile data is enabled, but data roaming is disabled. Wi-Fi is off and not connected. What should I do next?

Your phone shows excellent 5G signal and mobile data enabled, but data roaming is off. Roaming only matters if you're outside your home network.

Are you currently traveling outside your home network, for example abroad?
Yes, I am currently abroad in France, so I am outside my home network. Should I enable data roaming on my phone?

Yes. Your line is already roaming enabled on our side, so the only thing left is the phone's data roaming setting. Please use `toggle_roaming` to turn Data Roaming ON.

After that, run `run_speed_test` again and then `can_send_mms`. Tell me what each one shows.

Data Roaming is now ON.
Status Bar: 📶⁴ Excellent | 5G | 📱 Data Enabled | 🔋 80%
Speed Test Result: 275.00 Mbps (Excellent). Connection is very fast.
Your messaging app can send MMS messages.

I turned data roaming on. The speed test now shows an excellent connection with 275 Mbps download speed. Also, my messaging app can send MMS messages now. It looks like the issue is fixed. Is there anything else I should check or do?

Good news, John. Data roaming was the last piece. Your speed test is now excellent and MMS works.

You don't need to do anything else. To recap, we fixed these:
- Airplane mode is now off.
- Mobile data is now on.
- The network mode is now 4G/5G preferred, where it was 2G only.
- The messaging app now has the storage permission.
- Data roaming is now on.

Is there anything else I can help you with today?

Thank you for your help and clear guidance throughout the process. No, that's all I needed help with today. I appreciate your support in getting my MMS working again. Have a great day! 

###STOP###
